## Summary

Phase 4 (`phase_4_document_notification_data`) is complete: **PR #39** (https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/39) on `worker/task-20260724-133622-phase4-unify-document-pipeline-pdf-gener`.

What shipped:
- **Document Engine (11)**: `DOCUMENT_ENGINE_CONTRACT_2026-07-24.yaml` grounds the real, live shapes of `pdf-generator.ts`, the PaddleOCR `services/doc-processing` FastAPI service (found to be reachable only via GitHub Actions dispatch, never direct HTTP), `document-extraction-service.ts`, and `document-processing-engine.ts`. `scripts/document_engine.py` registers these 5 operations into Phase 1's live `capability_registry` and ports the hash-dedup logic.
- **Notification Engine (12)**: `NOTIFICATION_ENGINE_CONTRACT_2026-07-24.yaml` is the shared envelope schema unifying `notify-owner.py` (now committed to git for the first time — it was live but untracked) with the in-app `notifications` table. `scripts/notification_engine.py` implements the owner_email channel live.
- **Live cross-call**: a real `document-pipeline-failure-notify-owner` automation rule turns the plan's "planned" Document→Notification edge into "live" — verified end-to-end with an actual Resend email sent.
- **Data Engine (13)**: closed via a documented finding, not speculative build — confirmed zero ETL/pipeline need exists anywhere in either repo.
- The phase plan YAML was updated to `status: done` via a new `close_phase4_document_notification_data.py` script, and both contracts are registered in the knowledge engine (verified `query-knowledge` returns `found=2`).

One thing worth flagging: partway through I discovered my edits had landed in a shared worktree (`/opt/veridian/repos/claude-control`, on `master`) rather than this task's own dedicated worktree — I copied everything over to the correct worktree and cleaned up the shared one before committing, so no stray state was left behind.
